description: Implementation of the ZoneService interface for managing zones, including fetching zones by country and language, adding descriptions, and caching zone data.

classes.name: ZoneServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class for managing zones, providing methods for retrieving and updating zone data with caching support.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieve a Zone by its unique code.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Add a description to a zone, updating the zone if necessary.

methods.name: getZones
methods.description: Retrieve a list of zones for a given country and language, utilizing cache.

methods.name: getZones
methods.description: Retrieve a map of zones keyed by code for a given language, utilizing cache.
